rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the opening remarks of the press conference titled 野田内閣総理大臣記者会見 and dated 2 September 2011, 野田佳彦 said that he had that day, having received the Emperor's appointment, formally taken office as Prime Minister (本日、天皇陛下の親任を頂きまして、正式に内閣総理大臣に就任をさせていただきました).
